entity.description:
The messaging inbox is becoming the most valuable real estate on the phone. People live inside messaging apps. Brands want to meet customers there, but current tools make it difficult to engage in ways that feel helpful, branded, and trustworthy.

Most SMS marketing feels like spam. It comes from a random phone number or a 5-digit code. It contains random URLs that opens some page, force logins, or push app downloads. What should be the most personal, highest-conversion channel instead creates frustration, annoyance, and lost trust.

Kubbly helps brands become a verified contact on customers’ phones. Customers text the brand like they text a friend. Your brand's AI agent, powered by Kubbly, autonomously understands your customer, remembers context, and maintains conversation memory to serve them better every time, from intent to secure checkout.

We are laser-focused on helping brands use this channel aligned with your customer's needs to build long-term relationships, prioritizing trust over short-term wins. It behaves like a friend you would trust in iMessage or WhatsApp.Kubbly turns the message thread into a branded, interactive experience. Your customers browse, decide, and complete checkout inside the conversation. They stay in one place from intent to action.

We build the infrastructure that makes this work at scale. We verify identity and protect access. We preserve context across sessions so the experience improves over time. We enforce guardrails so the agent stays on brand and acts safely.

Brands use Kubbly to remove steps between intent and completion. They increase conversion because customers do not leave the inbox. They improve marketing ROI because each message completes a task, not just drives a click. They grow customer lifetime value because when you are in your buyers messaging apps, you are in their consideration set that much more often and that much more visible to them.
